subject: lean ninja in a black shinobi outfit with a red sash and mask, katana in the right hand
motion: a lightning-fast dash slash with the katana
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: blue speed lines behind the ninja and a white air-cut arc from the blade

plan.source: Right-facing three-quarter guard: right foot forward, left back wide; torso low; right hand holds katana low-forward pointing right; left hand open behind; head looking right.

frames.pose: Anticipation: weight shifts back onto left; right heel light; torso coils slightly left; right arm draws katana back by hip, tip angling up-left; left hand comes forward; head dips, eyes right. Left foot planted.

Key: explosive dash; both feet off ground, knees tucked; torso lunges right; right arm fully extends, katana slashes down-diagonal in front from above-right to below-right; left arm whips back; head forward.
frames.effect: Blue speed lines trailing behind torso/limbs to screen-left; big white air-cut arc in front along the katana’s down-right sweep.

frames.pose: Follow-through: land hard on right foot, left sliding in; torso past the cut, still leaning right; right arm finishes low across front, blade pointing down-right; left hand forward to counter; head steady.
frames.effect: Short blue lines trailing behind right arm, sash, and rear leg to screen-left.

frames.pose: Recovery: settle to wide stance; left steps back to plant, right knee bent; torso rises toward neutral; right hand returns katana to low-forward guard; left hand drifts back; head level, facing right.
